[[Category:Jacobian]]
The '''Jacobian determinant''', denoted by $\det \mathbf{J}_{\vec f}(\vec x)$, is the [[matrix#Determinant|determinant]] of a square [[Jacobian matrix]].

== Application ==

=== Volume transformation: change of variables ===

For an [[integrable function]] $g$ on $T(U)$, where $T:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R^n$ is a [[diffeomorphism]] and $U$ is a region in the $\vec x$-domain,

$$
\int_{T(U)} g(\vec y)\,d\vec y
=
\int_U g(T(\vec x))\,\left|\det \mathbf{J}_T(\vec x)\right|\,d\vec x.
$$

Where $T(U)=\{\,T(\vec x):\vec x\in U\,\}$ is the corresponding region of $U$ in the $\vec y$-domain.
